meta.requirement: Explore Wyrmrest Valley (30%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Waiting for Papa
start.text:
''A flat boulder sits off the main trail, dusted white. On top of it, a boy no taller than your knee has pulled his knees to his chest and wrapped his arms around them. His lips are blue at the edges.''

''He watches you approach without getting up.''

What_s_wrong_.text:
Boy: ''small voice'' I'm waiting for Papa.

''He doesn't uncurl.''

Boy: He told me to wait here. He said he'd come back.

choices.label: How long have you been waiting?

How_long_have_you_been_waiting_.text:
Boy: ''thinks hard'' Since before the sun was high. Eight hours, maybe. ''shivers'' I'm really cold.

''He presses his forehead to his knees.''

Boy: Papa said not to move. So I didn't.

Where_did_your_papa_go_.text:
Boy: ''points one stiff arm up the slope without looking''

Boy: Up there. He went to check something. A camp, he said. He'd be quick.

''He drops his arm.''

Boy: That was a long time ago.

choices.label: I'll look for him. First, let's get you somewhere warm

I_ll_look_for_him__First__let_s_get_you_.text:
Boy: ''looks up properly for the first time''

Boy: Somewhere warm?

''He tries to stand and wobbles. You steady him.''

Boy: ...Okay. But Papa has to know where I am.

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Bring the Boy to Springvale

Bring_the_Boy_to_Springvale.text:
''The boy stops shivering the moment Springvale's cookfires hit him. He looks around with wide eyes, then up at you.''

Boy: It's warm here.

''Draff passes with a bundle of kindling and slows, taking in the child's thin coat.''

Draff: Lost, is he?

Boy: ''clutching your sleeve'' I'm not lost. I'm waiting.

choices.label: He needs a place to sit by a fire

He_needs_a_place_to_sit_by_a_fire.text:
Draff: ''grunts'' Smokehouse has a bench. I'll put kettle water on.

''He jerks his chin toward the awning.''

Draff: Set him there. Tell him not to wander off again.

Boy: ''to you, urgent'' You'll find Papa, right? You said you would.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Drop the boy off somewhere warm in Springvale

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Drop Off

Drop_Off.text:
Boy: ''wrapped in a borrowed blanket on the smokehouse bench'' I'll stay here. I promise.

''He watches the kettle steam and doesn't let go of the blanket corner.''

Boy: ''quietly'' Please find him.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Search Wyrmrest Valley for the boy's father

continues.label: Go to Wyrmrest Valley (Dragonspine), do /rpg and click on Search Area

Search_Area.text:
''Higher on the trail, a canvas tent hunches against a rock shelf. The flap is tied shut, but smoke still curls from a stone ring out front. The ashes are warm when you touch them.''

''Someone camped here recently. The footprints leading away angle uphill, deeper into the white.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Search further up the valley for signs of the father

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, after that do /rpg again and then click on Search Area

Search_Area_.text:
''The trail narrows between frost-rimed pines. A wool scarf hangs snagged on a bramble, still damp. Boot prints overlap in the snow, two sets at first, then one, pressing hard toward the ridge.''

''Farther up, something guttural echoes off the stone. Chanting. Not wind.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Search the upper trail for the father

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, after that do /rpg again and then click on Search Area

Search_Area__.text:
''At a switchback below the ridge, a supply pack lies overturned in the drifts. Rations spilled. A hand axe half-buried. No blood, but the pack was dropped fast.''

''The chanting is louder now, just over the next rise. And underneath it, a man's voice, hoarse and desperate.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Continue upward on the mountain trail

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, after that do /rpg again and then click on Continue Upward

Continue_Upward.text:
''You crest the rise. A broad-shouldered man in a patched coat backs against a cliff face, one arm raised to block. Two Cryo Samachurls circle him, staffs scraping ice from the stone. A Cryo Slime bounces at his feet, leaving rime on his boots.''

Man: ''spotting you'' Don't— just stay back!

''One samachurl raises its staff. Frost blooms across the man's sleeve.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Fight off the Cryo Samachurls attacking the man on the slope

continues.label:
Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Samachurls. Defeat 2 [[Cryo Samachurl]]s and 1 [[Cryo Slime]].
If you defeated the enemies:

Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Samachurls. Defeat 2 [[Cryo Samachurl]]s and 1 [[Cryo Slime]].
If you got defeated by the enemies:

Fight_the_Samachurls_Win.text:
''The last samachurl collapses into scattered mask and frost. The man slides down the cliff wall, breathing hard, and presses a hand to his ribs.''

Man: ''disbelieving'' You... you actually came up here.

''He looks at the trail behind you, then at his own shaking hands.''

Man: My boy. Is he—

''You tell him about Springvale. Something in his face breaks open with relief.''

Man: Thank you. Gods, thank you. ''he pushes himself upright'' I'll walk. Just point me downhill.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Springvale and reunite the boy with his father

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Reunite the Boy and His Father

Fight_the_Samachurls_Lose.text:
''You reach the rise too late. The man is on his knees in the snow, frost spreading across his coat. The samachurls scatter at your approach, but the chanting fades into wind.''

''He tries to say something. Nothing comes out.''

''By the time you reach him, he is still.''

''Somewhere below, a boy is waiting on a smokehouse bench with a blanket and a kettle.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Decide what to do after what happened on the slope

choices.label: There's nothing more I can do here

____Waiting_for_Papa__Nothing_More_to_Do.title: Nothing More to Do
____Waiting_for_Papa__Nothing_More_to_Do.text:
''You stand on the rise for a moment. The wind takes the last of the frost from the man's sleeve.''

''Below, Springvale's smoke rises into a grey sky. A boy waits on a bench with a blanket he will not let go of.''

''You turn downhill. The valley does not ask what you decided.''

I_need_to_tell_him.text:
''The walk back to Springvale is longer than it should be.''

''You rehearse words that will not fit together. At the smokehouse bench, the boy sees your face before you speak.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Springvale and tell the boy what happened

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Tell the Boy

Reunite_the_Boy_and_His_Father.text:
''The boy is on his feet before his father clears the awning. The blanket drops. Neither of them speaks for a moment.''

Boy: Papa!

Man: ''dropping to one knee, wincing'' I'm here. I'm here. ''pulls him close'' I told you to wait. You waited.

''The boy sobs once into his father's shoulder, then stops, as if remembering he is too old for that.''

Man: ''looking up at you'' You brought him down. You came up after me. ''counts coins from a frozen pouch with stiff fingers'' It's not enough. It's what I have.

''He hesitates, then unbuckles a sword from his pack. The blade is pale blue, frosted along the edge, still sharp.''

Man: Cool Steel. Carried it up the mountain. ''shoves it into your hands'' Take it. I owe you more than silver for this.

Draff: ''from the doorway, arms crossed'' Get inside before you freeze again. Both of you.

____Waiting_for_Papa__Family_Reunited.title: Family Reunited
____Waiting_for_Papa__Family_Reunited.text:
''The smokehouse door closes on warmth and low voices. Through the window you see the boy pressed against his father's side, both of them finally still.''

''Dragonspine keeps its cold. Tonight, at least one bench in Springvale does not.''

Tell_the_Boy.text:
Boy: ''already standing'' Did you find him? Is he—

''You tell him. Quietly. As plain as you can make it.''

''He doesn't cry right away. He looks at the kettle. At the blanket. At the spot on the bench where he waited.''

Boy: ''very small'' He told me not to move.

''Then his face crumples and he sits down hard, both hands over his eyes. Draff turns away and busies himself with the kettle.''

Draff: ''roughly, not unkind'' Stay as long as you need, lad.

____Waiting_for_Papa__The_Hard_Truth.title: The Hard Truth
____Waiting_for_Papa__The_Hard_Truth.text:
''You step back into the cold. The boy's shoulders shake once behind you, then go still.''

''Some things you carry down the mountain whether you want to or not.''
